extraction.name: LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data
extraction.description: LUMA is a unique multimodal dataset designed for benchmarking multimodal learning algorithms on uncertain data. It includes audio, image, and textual data from 50 classes, specifically designed to study the impact of uncertainty in multimodal deep learning. The dataset extends the CIFAR 10/100 dataset with audio samples from three audio corpora and text data generated using the Gemma-7B LLM. LUMA enables controlled injection of varying types and degrees of uncertainty for tailored experiments and benchmarking. It is available as a Python package with functions for generating dataset variants, controlling data diversity, noise levels, and adding out-of-distribution samples. A baseline pre-trained model and three uncertainty quantification methods (Monte-Carlo Dropout, Deep Ensemble, and Reliable Conflictive Multi-View Learning) are provided.
extraction.creator: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, Sébastien Foumier

extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset includes 101,000 images from CIFAR 10/100, 135,096 speech audio recordings extracted from The Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, and Mozilla Common Voice corpora, and 62,875 text passages generated using the Gemma-7B LLM. Audio samples were validated using Whisper Large V3 for automatic transcription and manual validation via Label Studio. Text data was validated by masking label occurrences and reclassifying with Gemma-7B. The dataset was compiled with 42 in-distribution classes (600 samples each) and 8 out-of-distribution classes (3,859 samples).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Software Collection, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images from CIFAR 10/100 dataset; audio samples from The Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, and Mozilla Common Voice corpora; text data generated using Gemma-7B LLM.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset includes a Python package for generating customized versions with varying levels and types of noise (aleatoric and epistemic) and uncertainty. Noise types include background noise for audio, text noise (keyboard, OCR, random character/word, antonym, spelling, back-translation), and image noise (Gaussian, shot, impulse, blur, snow, frost, fog, brightness/contrast adjustments, pixelation, JPEG compression). Label noise is injected by reassigning labels to semantically close classes based on deep feature distances.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Audio samples were validated using Whisper Large V3 for automatic transcription and manual validation via Label Studio. Text data was validated by masking label occurrences and reclassifying with Gemma-7B. Images were aligned with other modalities to ensure correspondence. The dataset was compiled with 600 samples per in-distribution class (500 training, 100 testing) and 3,859 out-of-distribution samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Audio samples were validated by checking if transcriptions matched class labels (or plural forms). Text data was validated by masking label occurrences and reclassifying with Gemma-7B. Bias analysis was performed using Gemma-7B to detect gender, racial, religious, or cultural biases in text samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Label Studio for audio validation; Gemma-7B LLM for text validation and bias detection.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Bias analysis revealed significant gender bias in classes 'man', 'woman', 'boy', and 'girl'. Prompts were reconstructed to minimize bias, and unbiased texts were filtered for inclusion. The dataset includes 2 annotations per audio sample via Label Studio, with 71.61% agreement.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: 17 annotators (M.Sc. and PhD students, and professors) with advanced to fluent English knowledge participated in audio validation via Label Studio.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Whisper Large V3 for audio transcription; Gemma-7B LLM for text generation, validation, and bias detection; Label Studio for manual audio validation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is available as a Python package with functions for generating dataset variants. The code and instructions for downloading and processing the dataset are provided at https://github.com/bezirganyan/LUMA. The dataset is hosted on Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/bezirganyan/LUMA).
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Audio samples include diverse accents and pronunciations, which may indirectly reflect sensitive attributes like language proficiency or regional background. Text data includes generated content that may contain biases related to gender, race, religion, or culture.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is designed to study uncertainty quantification in multimodal deep learning, which is critical for safety-critical applications like healthcare and autonomous driving. The dataset includes bias analysis and mitigation strategies to reduce harmful stereotypes in generated text.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Significant gender bias was detected in text samples for classes 'man', 'woman', 'boy', and 'girl'. The dataset includes bias mitigation strategies, such as reconstructing prompts to minimize bias and filtering unbiased texts. The dataset may also contain factual inaccuracies due to LLM-generated text.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to 50 classes, with 42 in-distribution and 8 out-of-distribution classes. The text data is generated using an LLM, which may introduce factual inaccuracies or biases. The audio data includes misaligned segments and noisy samples, which were partially mitigated through validation. The dataset is not intended as a source of knowledge or information but as a benchmark for uncertainty quantification.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Benchmarking of multimodal deep learning models for uncertainty quantification. The dataset is intended for research in trustworthy and robust machine learning approaches for safety-critical applications.
